review.note: Approval behavior passed independent probes; stale V6-19 regression evidence was regenerated and re-verified. Final: 6/6, deps 200/200, tsc/build 0.

dependencyStatus: V6-19 accepted (review-05) and V6-23 accepted (review-06); integration de8247c merged into this branch.

acceptance.observed: A valid professional snapshot with a current check, current confirmations and acknowledged risks creates a contract Approval; revocation is append-only and visible. Browser steps confirm the approval record and one event.

The panel never claims legal signature or submission and labels output as preparation material. Rebinding a figure makes the old approval stale with STALE_BINDING; check replacement and cited-confirmation revocation invalidate with APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
Refresh/retry reuses the same approval and one approval.created event; rule-pack and input changes are recomputed live without duplicate side effects.

specAcceptance.reason: XML export format selection belongs to V6-25; this ticket creates the internal approval only.
Export manifest hashing belongs to V6-25.
Figure rebinding makes the approval stale and reports STALE_BINDING (test + browser).
An unacknowledged risk blocks; risk_ack clears only its current check run (test).
An editor approval attempt returns ACTION_FORBIDDEN with no stored record or event (test).
Recovery import idempotency belongs to V6-26.
The completion page belongs to V6-25.
Recovery package generation belongs to V6-26.

limitations: Approval is an internal team record, not a legal signature or a filing; the UI never displays 法定签署/已递交.
The panel is exported but not registered in V6App/navigation; shared registration is orchestrator-owned.
Browser evidence uses a direct synthetic mount with an in-memory LocalRepository; native IndexedDB and app routing are unverified.
Legal rules are unverified under G-RULES closed; no legal blocker is claimed.
No real provider, network call or customer material was used.
Node 25.8.1 was used; the architecture target Node 22 remains unverified.
